items.headline: I'M THE SAME OUT NOW
body: Lockslip returns with their final single "IM THE SAME" ahead of their debut album "THE CONVERSATION"s release next week on November 6th.
"IM THE SAME" sees Lockslip take their wall of sound aggression to melodic spaces without compromising integrity or intensity.
IM THE SAME is available now via bleakhouse

"I'm the Same" is a two-minute burst of relentless blasting and cathartic vocals, crowned by a spiraling, wistful guitar melody that tips the hat to the band's screamo influences. It is a juxtaposition of elements – the punishing and the pensive – that brings to mind contemporaries such as Cloud Rat and Converge.

For the official "I'm the Same" music video, the band teamed up with digital artist @Freeculture.api, who delivered a deliciously retro, Y2K-era aesthetic, depicting a chilling vampiric tale, just in time for Halloween. Drummer Noah Baxter elaborates: "Freeculture.api is a digital artist I've followed for years now, part of this renaissance of low poly and early 3D revival in computer art and animation. Growing up, I spent a lot of time in these 3D digital spaces, sometimes surrounded by others but more often alone with my thoughts, so when this song came together and I read Sara's lyrics it just made sense to me, as a way to visually describe the alien and abstract way we actually inhabit our own heads."

items.headline: VENGEANCE (YOU'LL BE SEEN BY YOUR GOD) OUT NOW
body: "Vengeance (You'll Be Seen By Your God)" is the second single to be revealed from the band's upcoming new album, The Conversation, coming November 6th on Bleakhouse. See the official music video premiering exclusively through CVLT Nation.
"The state of the world is complex, it's dark, and it's unpredictable, so we want to write music that reflects those anxieties" - Sara G.

items.headline: GRAY WORLD FT. KING YOSEF OUT NOW
body: Lockslip's debut bleakhouse single "GRAY WORLD FT. KING YOSEF" is out now with a music video. Watch or stream it on your preferred platform.
Lockslip's debut album "THE CONVERSATION" is due out November 6th via bleakhouse. Pre-orders are now live.

items.headline: LOCKSLIP SIGNS TO BLEAKHOUSE
body: we are very pleased to welcome LOCKSLIP to the team here at bleakhouse
LOCKSLIP is a metallic hardcore band based out of Los Angeles. with full force, they bring you feedback-laden anguish that is palpable in both recording and performance
with one self released EP under their belt and shows on the horizon, we are proud to be working with them for future releases
